pygal.definition:
a. Situated in the region of the rump, or posterior end of the
   backbone; -- applied especially to the posterior median plates in the
   carapace of chelonians.

pygidium.definition:
n. The caudal plate of trilobites, crustacean, and certain
   insects. See Illust. of Limulus and Trilobite.

pygmaean.translation: a. 矮人的, 矮小的, 微少的, 无足轻重的, 微薄的

pygmalion.definition: n. (Greek mythology) a king who created a statue of a woman and fell in love with it; Aphrodite brought the sculpture to life as Galatea
pygmalion.translation: n. 皮格马利翁(希腊神话人物)

pygmalionism.translation: [医] 爱偶像癖, 爱雕像癖

pygmean.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a pygmy; resembling a pygmy or dwarf;
   dwarfish; very small.

pygmies.translation: n. 俾格米人( pygmy的名词复数 ); 特别矮小的人或动物, 特别小的东西

pygmoid.translation: a. 俾格米人似的, 矮小的

pygmy.definition:
n. an unusually small individual
n. any member of various peoples having an average height of less than five feet
pygmy.translation:
n. 矮人, 侏儒
a. 矮小的

pygmy marmoset.translation: [网络] 侏儒狨猴；倭狨；这是是侏儒猴

pygmy sperm whale.translation: [网络] 小抹香鲸；矮抹香鲸；小抺香鲸

pygochord.translation: [动]尾索, 某些半索类小肠的腹正中嵴状突起

pygomelus.translation: [医] 臀肢畸胎, 臀部寄生肢畸胎

pygopagus parasiticus.translation: [医] 臀部寄生胎(不对称性臀部联胎)

pygopod.definition:
n. One of the Pygopodes.
n. Any species of serpentiform lizards of the family
   Pygopodidae, which have rudimentary hind legs near the anal cleft, but
   lack fore legs.

pygoscelis.translation: [网络] 阿德利企鹅属；阿德里企鹅属；巴布亚企鹅是阿德利企鹅属

pygoscelis adeliae.translation: [网络] 阿德利企鹅；阿德里企鹅；阿德莱企鹅

pygostyle.definition:
n. The plate of bone which forms the posterior end of the
   vertebral column in most birds; the plowshare bone; the vomer. It is
   formed by the union of a number of the last caudal vertebrae, and
   supports the uropigium.
